# Checkbox

```tsx
import { Checkbox, CheckboxGroup } from "@s0l/design-system"
```

Toggles a single option on or off. Mirrors the Figma Checkbox: State (Default / Read Only / Disabled), Active, Indeterminate, Label, Label Position, Description and Nested.

## Example

From the Storybook story; names like `args` or `label` are the story controls.

```tsx
<Checkbox
  {...args}
  aria-label={args.label ? undefined : "Label"}
  onCheckedChange={(checked, details) => {
    updateArgs({ checked, indeterminate: false })
    args.onCheckedChange?.(checked, details)
  }}
/>
```

## Figma notes

Mirrors the Figma Checkbox component:
- State: Default, Read Only (`readOnly`), Disabled (`disabled`)
- Active (`checked`) and Indeterminate (`indeterminate`)
- Show Label / Label Position / Description / Nested as props The accent fill only applies to an interactive box; Read Only and Disabled keep an outlined box with a tinted mark. Read Only can't be changed, so it has no Focus and leaves the tab order.

## Props

Documented props only; every component also accepts the props of the element or Base UI part it renders (`className`, events, ARIA…).

`Checkbox`:

| Prop | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `label?` | `React.ReactNode` | Figma "Label" (Show Label). Without it only the box renders. |
| `description?` | `React.ReactNode` | Figma "Description" (Show Description). |
| `labelPosition?` | `"right" \| "left"` | Figma "Label Position". |
| `nested?` | `boolean` | Figma "Nested": indents the checkbox under a parent one. |
| `showNestIndicator?` | `boolean` | Figma "Show Nest Indicator": the └ connector of a nested checkbox. |

`CheckboxGroup`:

| Prop | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `label?` | `React.ReactNode` | Group label (Figma .Label). |
| `helpText?` | `React.ReactNode` | Figma "Show Text Help". |
| `direction?` | `"vertical" \| "horizontal"` | Figma "Direction". |

## Rules

- Import `Checkbox` from `@s0l/design-system`. Do not rebuild it with plain HTML and Tailwind classes.
- Style it through its props and variants first. Use `className` only for layout (margin, width, grid placement), never to change its colors, typography or radius.
- Colors come from the S0L tokens; see [color](../foundations/color.md).
